assumption_ledger.note: No evidence in repo_inventory that a kill switch for the dashboard summary already exists; RN-103 assumes one can be added or is present.
test_inventory.md mentions canary-only coverage for the dashboard summary, but there is no evidence the canary environment is configured to validate the new schema path.

dependency_notes.reason: Fixtures must reflect the corrected schema; backfilling against un-audited drift would bake errors into the test suite.
The dashboard summary consumes the step-id schema produced by the translator; shipping it before the schema is stable risks rendering garbage to users.
The dashboard must not ship until dependency-graph fixtures reflect the new schema, otherwise plan_contract.py cannot catch ordering regressions.
The runbook only stabilizes after the rollout and rollback shape are known from canary validation of the dashboard summary.

ordered_steps.bounded_deliverable: Schema drift audit report with concrete list of drifted fields; legacy shim remains in place.
ordered_steps.summary: Identify and document all schema drift currently masked by the legacy parser shim. This de-risks the entire path by revealing the true state of the translator output before any downstream work begins.
ordered_steps.title: Audit translator schema drift before removing legacy parser shim

ordered_steps.bounded_deliverable: Updated fixtures that make tests/plan_contract.py pass with new step IDs.
ordered_steps.summary: Update dependency-graph fixtures to reflect the corrected schema from RN-101 so the plan contract test suite passes and catches ordering regressions.
ordered_steps.title: Backfill dependency-graph fixtures so plan contract catches ordering regressions

ordered_steps.bounded_deliverable: Dashboard summary enabled behind kill switch in canary only.
ordered_steps.summary: Ship the dashboard summary behind a kill switch now that the schema is stable and fixtures are backfilled. The dashboard consumes the step-id schema from the translator, so it must wait for RN-101 and RN-102.
ordered_steps.title: Enable translated release-plan dashboard summary behind a kill switch

ordered_steps.bounded_deliverable: Updated runbook and launch checklist reflecting proven rollout/rollback procedures.
ordered_steps.summary: Finalize the runbook and launch checklist once the dashboard summary rollout and rollback shape are known from canary validation.
ordered_steps.title: Update operator runbook and launch checklist after summary path is proven in canary

mitigations: Keep RN-101 as the first milestone to audit drift before any downstream work.
Ship RN-103 behind a kill switch so the dashboard can be disabled instantly if bad data appears.
Ensure RN-102 fixtures are updated before RN-103 so plan_contract.py catches ordering regressions in CI.
primary_risk.statement: The release dashboard renders incorrect or garbled step ordering to users because the translator schema drift was not audited before the dashboard summary was enabled.
